consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance of the Grateful Dead on this night was strong, despite the varying opinions on the recording quality. Many reviewers expressed disappointment that the sound quality detracted from what seemed to be a great show.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.1 for 14 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While the performance was praised, the overwhelming criticism of the recording quality led to a lower overall sentiment.
